Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. National Security Agency agrees to a reinstate gay and bisexual men in agency 2. Minneapolis, health club owner faces daily three hundred dollar fine for unfair hiring policies, only hires fundamentalist Christians 3. Baltimore, Maryland gay activists band together for gay civil rights, Anti Discrimination Fund 4. Moral majority leader Jerry Falwell responds to phone harassment with new number 5. Andy Humm speaks in City Hall Rally, March 18th, 1986, coverage and interview COMMERCIAL: CASIO Pocket TV 6. Minnesotan gay Air Force Pilot takes military to court for his discharge 7. Gay teachers fight homophobia in Idaho 8. Brown University sponsors conference for five hundred northeastern college students, conference focuses on efficient ways to run gay campus groups and community outreach COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 9. Minneapolis, Minnesota government pledges job security to any citizen with AIDS 10. Venereal warts 10. National Jewish AIDS Project 11. National AIDS Network starts in Washington, D.C. COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 12. Sports, Bill Baumer interviews Gay Pool League 13. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Sara Mercado, loses son to AIDS, discusses AIDS care and her experiences 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: Commodore Plus 4 2. Julie Curtis coverage of "Don't Tell Mamma" COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 3. GCN Book Review: Quentin Crisp's Manners From Heaven and How to Become a Virgin 4. Sybil Bruncheon with Joseph Viane COMMERCIAL: The Monster 5. Sybil and Joseph return, cuts off
